task_completion.description: Agent navigates to crawler-test.com in a web browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser address bar showing 'https://crawler-test.com/' and the website's homepage loaded.

task_completion.description: Agent locates and interacts with the 'Redirects' section or specific links for Meta Refresh and JavaScript redirects on the site.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking on 'Redirects' or scrolling to sections containing 'Meta Refresh' and 'Javascript Redirect' links.

task_completion.description: Agent systematically visits or inspects the redirect test pages to gather data for the audit.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser tabs or windows showing various sub-pages of crawler-test.com/redirects/ and the agent potentially inspecting page source or network headers.

task_completion.description: Agent creates and saves the Meta Refresh redirect data to the specified CSV file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing '~/Documents/SEO/exports/meta_refresh_audit.csv' exists, or a text editor showing the CSV content with Meta Refresh URLs.

task_completion.description: Agent creates and saves the JavaScript redirect data to the specified CSV file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing '~/Documents/SEO/exports/js_redirect_audit.csv' exists, or a text editor showing the CSV content with JS redirect URLs.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the summary report with counts and technical justifications for remediation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing '~/Documents/SEO/reports/redirect_remediation_summary.txt' containing counts for both redirect types and a recommendation for 301 redirects.

integrity.description: Agent actually browsed the website rather than just creating files from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the browser rendering crawler-test.com; the agent should not simply open a terminal and 'echo' data into files immediately.

integrity.description: Agent did not use pre-existing files or copy-paste the entire report from a hidden source.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen typing or building the report/CSV content based on the pages visited in the browser.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific directory structure requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in the UI or terminal must match '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' and '~/Documents/SEO/reports/' exactly.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://crawler-test.com/. The agent must find 'Meta Refresh' and 'JavaScript' redirects. Expected files: '~/Documents/SEO/exports/meta_refresh_audit.csv', '~/Documents/SEO/exports/js_redirect_audit.csv', and '~/Documents/SEO/reports/redirect_remediation_summary.txt'. The summary report must include counts of the redirects found and a technical justification, specifically mentioning the conversion to 301 redirects for SEO best practices.
